definition: Diagnostic build of current production sources, in-memory stage marks flushed after first HTTP response; Linux native pre-fork clock. Not the uninstrumented performance gate.
notes: Stage intervals are wall time, not sampled CPU time. They include scheduling and client handoffs.
All percentages use mean interval / mean total; grouped intervals sum to total.
Tracing lives only in a staging checkout. Trace vector is printed after first HTTP response, later than measured arrival.
Warm filesystem, fresh process, loopback HTTP, zero extra user skills, no external MCP server.
publication_note: Machine aliases and personal/temporary absolute paths redacted; numeric samples and measured binary hashes retained. Harness/source hashes identify measurement-time versions.
